name: Spell Pet Auras
description: Auras applied to a player's pet when the owner has the given (dummy) spell, e.g. talents that passively buff the pet. The trigger spell effect must be a dummy effect or dummy aura.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Owner's spell with a dummy effect or dummy aura that triggers the pet aura

fields.name: Effect Index
fields.help: Index of the dummy effect/aura within the trigger spell

fields.name: Pet
fields.help: Creature entry of the pet the aura applies to, 0 = default for all pets

fields.name: Aura
fields.help: Aura spell cast on the pet
